BY_TYPE.rebar_support: all 10 rebar_support_* fields as labeled, unit-hinted descriptors; introduces two descriptor types — 'select' (options list; blank clears to null) and 'list' (comma-separated draft -> string array on save).

New exports listFieldDraft(value) (array -> '#3, #4' draft; absent -> ''; anything else verbatim) and listFieldValue(value) (string -> token array; blank -> []; array passthrough; non-string/non-array VERBATIM fail-closed).

Field renderer gains 'select' (native <select> matching the dialog's own material_type picker — blank option -> null; stored out-of-enum value renders as an extra verbatim option, never remapped) and 'list' (text input over listFieldDraft, raw draft kept in form state).
handleSave: list-typed fields of the active type run through listFieldValue before CAS write — '#3, #4' -> ['#3','#4'], blank -> [], untouched stored arrays/malformed values pass through verbatim.
Numeric fields unchanged: inventoryNumberInput boundary (blank->null, numeric->Number, malformed->verbatim, explicit-0 honored).

TAB_CONFIGS += 'supports' (label 'Rebar Support', types ['rebar_support']) inserted between 'rebar' and 'forming' — object order drives generic TabsContent order; matching <TabsTrigger value='supports'>Supports</TabsTrigger> added between Rebar and Forming triggers. Renders in BOTH standalone page and embedded Master Inventory → Concrete & Stone modes (only equipment/poles are non-embedded — supports is a material).

supports field list: all 10 rebar_support_* fields + supplier/unit/cost_per_unit/notes. kind = optional select (blank sentinel -> null, 'other hardware stays untyped' per schema doc); numeric metadata fields carry default:null so a new row never fabricates 0-inch heights (cost_per_unit keeps the sibling-tab convention number->0 = explicit authored free price, visible to the admin).

GenericItemForm: defaults loop honors f.default and f.optional; select renderer gains '__unspecified__' sentinel (radix SelectItem rejects ''); new 'list' renderer (comma draft via listFieldDraft); Save button maps list fields through listFieldValue before onSave.
GenericTab displayFields: array values join ', ' (defensive — keeps list fields displayable if reordered into the first-4 slice).
FOUNDATION_SUPPLY_TYPES += 'rebar_support' — drives both row visibility AND the foundation-source type <Select> options (FOUNDATION_TYPE_OPTIONS is derived).

passThroughFoundation passKeys += all 10 rebar_support_* fields — DATA-LOSS FIX: without this, editing a support row through the Supplies tab rebuilt the form without support metadata and replaceEntityFieldsIfUnchanged would write it back stripped.

FoundationInventory allowlists in 'supplies' and 'concrete_stone' SOURCES += 'rebar_support' (mirrors wherever 'rebar' appears — Master Part Picker can now see support rows, grouped under Concrete & Stone).

verification.browser_note: Full-app browser verification not possible within mandate: candidates are not deployable (no remote writes permitted) and local src/ is stale (missing remote-only inventoryNormalization.js — local tree cannot compile current remote state). Real-component mounts exercise create/edit/list/filter on all four admin surfaces; responsive layout is inherited unchanged (dialog grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 = mobile stacked / desktop 2-col; catalog chips overflow-x-auto; tab bar flex-wrap).

residual_risks_and_notes: rebar_support_pack_size is schema-integer; number input can produce a fractional value — stored verbatim per boundary contract, entity integer validation on write is the fail-closed backstop (admin sees save error).
FoundationInventory.jsx generic form keeps the sibling-tab convention cost_per_unit default 0 (explicit authored free price, visible); support metadata fields are the ones defaulted to null.
Switching material_type mid-edit in FoundationMaterialDialog leaves prior-type fields on the record (pre-existing behavior for all types, unchanged).
ExcelImporterDialog has no rebar_support mapper — bulk import of supports is a follow-up if wanted; manual catalog authoring is fully covered.

Estimator/BOM consumption of rebar_support rows (placement math, spacing, pack rounding, unavailable-issue emission) is entirely Phase B-2 scope; this work only makes the records catalogable, visible, editable, and pickable.
